material_news_signals.headline: Patriots-Seahawks in 2026 NFL Kickoff Game: What We Learned from Seattle's 13-10 win
material_news_signals.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players next gen stats insight for patriots seahawks via nfl pro drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame

material_news_signals.headline: Report: Patriots to place A.J. Brown (ankle) on injured reserve, sidelining WR at least four games
material_news_signals.description: The New England Patriots are placing wide receiver A.J. Brown on injured reserve after the star receiver suffered an ankle injury during's Wednesday's kickoff game against the Seahawks, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
material_news_signals.body_text: the new england patriots prized offseason acquisition will be sidelined for the next month new england is placing receiver a j brown on injured reserve after he suffered an ankle injury in wednesday s season opening loss to seattle espn s adam schefter reported the roster move will prevent brown from playing for at least four games before he is eligible to return from ir the patriots next four games are home vs pittsburgh and jacksonville and buffalo before a week 5 home game vs las vegas nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on thursday that an mri confirmed that brown suffered a high ankle sprain early in the second half of wednesday s game high ankle sprains typically have a recovery time of about four to six weeks brown suffered the injury when his foot was trapped awkwardly between the turf and a seahawks defender while attempting to make a third down catch a three time pro bowler with six 1 000 yard seasons in seven years brown was traded from philadelphia to new england in a june blockbuster deal that netted new england s 2028 first round pick and a 2027 fifth round selection the move reunited brown with his first nfl head coach mike vrabel who directed brown in his first few years in tennessee brown s arrival provided the patriots with an unquestioned no 1 receiver with star power and big play potential an element new england lacked during its run to super bowl lx in 2025 with brown on the roster the nfl s third ranked offense was expected to be even more productive in 2026 instead quarterback drake maye and the patriots will have to manage without brown for at least next month

star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players next gen stats insight for patriots seahawks via nfl pro drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame

material_news_signals.headline: Broncos' Courtland Sutton: Bo Nix has been 'like a mountain lion' awaiting his Week 1 return
material_news_signals.description: With all the attention on Patrick Mahomes returning for the Kansas City Chiefs on Monday night at Arrowhead Stadium, Bo Nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat, but the Denver Broncos quarterback feels ready to roll.
material_news_signals.body_text: with all the attention on patrick mahomes returning for the kansas city chiefs on monday night at arrowhead stadium bo nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat the denver broncos quarterback missed the afc championship game after suffering a right ankle fracture late in a divisional round win over buffalo the prevailing theory is that had nix been healthy the broncos would have been playing in santa clara for the super bowl in february the qb has been cleared for most of the offseason last month he participated in 14 preseason snaps dipping his toe in the water nix s full return comes monday night in prime time as the broncos set out to defend their afc west title i m just excited to get out there nix said via the team s official website i feel like i m pacing and feel like i ve been in this practice schedule for a long time it s exciting to go out there and play another team it s really exciting and i know that our guys are going to respond well i feel like i have a great group with me that i m going in here with i can t wait in two seasons nix has not missed a passing snap in his regular season career and denver was the only team not to have a backup qb attempt a pass in 2024 and 2025 per nfl research receiver courtland sutton said nix s eagerness to return is obvious he s a competitor now sutton said i m looking forward to watching him go out there he s like a mountain lion that s in the zoo that s just pacing i saw a mountain lion at the colorado zoo he was just pacing back and forth and i was like y all don t want that boy to get out it s not going to be good that s what bo reminds me of nix has led the broncos to 24 career wins tied for the most over a player s first two seasons since 1950 russell wilson denver is 3 1 versus the chiefs with nix as a starter having lost the first matchup before taking the next three the club was 1 15 versus k c from 2016 2023 before drafting nix in 2024 the afc west champs starting the season off on the road won t be an easy first step in their effort to repeat but it s probably better to play mahomes at arrowhead early in his return rather than later

material_news_signals.description: With all the attention on Patrick Mahomes returning for the Kansas City Chiefs on Monday night at Arrowhead Stadium, Bo Nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat, but the Denver Broncos quarterback feels ready to roll.
material_news_signals.body_text: with all the attention on patrick mahomes returning for the kansas city chiefs on monday night at arrowhead stadium bo nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat the denver broncos quarterback missed the afc championship game after suffering a right ankle fracture late in a divisional round win over buffalo the prevailing theory is that had nix been healthy the broncos would have been playing in santa clara for the super bowl in february the qb has been cleared for most of the offseason last month he participated in 14 preseason snaps dipping his toe in the water nix s full return comes monday night in prime time as the broncos set out to defend their afc west title i m just excited to get out there nix said via the team s official website i feel like i m pacing and feel like i ve been in this practice schedule for a long time it s exciting to go out there and play another team it s really exciting and i know that our guys are going to respond well i feel like i have a great group with me that i m going in here with i can t wait in two seasons nix has not missed a passing snap in his regular season career and denver was the only team not to have a backup qb attempt a pass in 2024 and 2025 per nfl research receiver courtland sutton said nix s eagerness to return is obvious he s a competitor now sutton said i m looking forward to watching him go out there he s like a mountain lion that s in the zoo that s just pacing i saw a mountain lion at the colorado zoo he was just pacing back and forth and i was like y all don t want that boy to get out it s not going to be good that s what bo reminds me of nix has led the broncos to 24 career wins tied for the most over a player s first two seasons since 1950 russell wilson denver is 3 1 versus the chiefs with nix as a starter having lost the first matchup before taking the next three the club was 1 15 versus k c from 2016 2023 before drafting nix in 2024 the afc west champs starting the season off on the road won t be an easy first step in their effort to repeat but it s probably better to play mahomes at arrowhead early in his return rather than later

outplayed us in every facet rams coach sean mcvay said i didn t do nearly a good enough job this is a humbling day for us this will define us only if we allow it to today was one of those days the rams took a 7 3 lead early in the second quarter on the strength of a puka nacua 41 yard catch and run from there things devolved over the next five drives the rams generated nine first downs matthew stafford tossed an interception tyler higbee lost a fumble and the team turned it over on downs twice including once at the 1 yard line meanwhile a revamped defense allowed the niners to move up and down the field san francisco scored on five of its nine possessions and punted just twice both in the first half i always look inside out mcvay said i didn t do a good enough job getting us ready to go there were some opportunities where maybe the game could have flipped but they deserved the win they were ready to go and we ll look at it we ll see where we can improve and be better moving forward but this is a good humbling day this is what can sometimes happen in sports i love this locker room and you know the first thing that i m going to look at is myself and i have to do a better job for a group collectively with our coaches with our players and we ll look at this film and we ll get back to work because clearly that s obviously what we ve got to do and sometimes sports can humble you and today was one of those days much was made about the rams decision to make the 15 hour flight to melbourne late in the week while the niners spent the entire week down under whether it their fewest in any of the 75 games with stafford as their starter the seven point total marks just the second stafford start for the rams with fewer than 10 points scored the other came in week 4 of material_news_signals.headline: Patriots-Seahawks in 2026 NFL Kickoff Game: What We Learned from Seattle's 13-10 win
material_news_signals.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players next gen stats insight for patriots seahawks via nfl pro drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame
